calibration_scope: Effective thrust/mass curve from0.21-0.335 mean command. Known1.5m gate pixels, public gyro, own commands; no native fitting labels.
method: Conditional vertical displacement over a pulse and350ms recovery. Initial position/velocity use only pre-pulse pixels. Camera mount, clock mapping and drag are frozen. Motor second moment is mean(u²), not mean(u)².

training.metric: Future camera-derived vertical position error. Initial position/velocity use only images before each pulse; no future state fit.

heldout.metric: Future camera-derived vertical position error. Initial position/velocity use only images before each pulse; no future state fit.
heldout.image_selection: Raw measured aperture corners with geometric quality checks; no estimator acceptance filter
heldout.acceptance_rule: Six command levels, no parameter refit: future camera-position RMS<=0.12m, >=15% reduction from prior, each pulse RMS<=0.20m.

interpretation: One complete independent response-validation flight with six pulse windows. One earlier validation attempt was incomplete. Two development lap attempts failed; the opposite-shift lap completed. The current visibility policy completed1/2 trials. This is not a robust or fast-lap result.

rejected_measurement_model.reason: Large raw specific-force spikes at constant commands; the direct fit was rejected. Camera displacement supplied the final physical-response labels.

limits: Global position MAE2.75m and P957.05m remain poor.
The complete-flight comparison uses different shifted starts and revisions, not a controlled before/after.
The calibrated quantity is short-window vertical response, not full navigation accuracy.
True exposure time and actuator application delay remain unresolved.
Some startup commands slightly exceed the measured mean-command range; coverage is recorded per run.
Body clearance and calibrated joint posterior coverage remain unknown.
